title: The IBM 1401 compiles and runs FORTRAN II
summary: CuriousMarc and colleagues at the Computer History Museum try to compile and run a FORTRAN II program on a 1959 IBM 1401. The machine has only 16k of memory and a CPU not meant for scientific work, so success is far from guaranteed.
why: Passed around in computing-history threads as a charming example of vintage hardware being coaxed into running FORTRAN.

quote.text: A computer from 1959 (IBM 1401) at the Computer History Museum, compiling FORTRAN.
